item.title: Russian attacks kill 3, injure 20 in Ukraine over past day
item.description: Russia launched 117 drones, including Shahed-type unmanned aerial vehicles, and two Iskander-M ballistic missiles overnight, the Air Force reported.

item.title: After six years at the front, here is what nobody tells you about being a woman at war
item.description: This May will mark six years since I put on a military uniform and began serving in the same marine infantry unit — first as a combat medic in a reconnaissance platoon, and now as a strike drone operator.I have witnessed three distinct forms of war: the forgotten trench

item.title: Ukraine's Shrike Fiber drone wins top place in Pentagon drone procurement program
item.description: Ukrainian company Sky Fall’s Shrike Fiber drone reportedly took first place in the Pentagon’s Drone Dominance selection in partnership with U.K.-based Skycutter, Defender Media reported March 7.

item.title: Iranian drone that struck British air base contained Russian technology, Times reports
item.description: A drone that struck a U.K. air base in Akrotiri on the island of Cyprus on March 1 contained Russian technology, the Times reported March 7.

item.title: New Dutch prime minister visits Kyiv two weeks after taking office
item.description: Zelensky said that he and the Dutch leader had discussed investments in arms production, its possible scope, and the licensing of weapons.

item.title: Iran names new Supreme Leader
item.description: Hard-line cleric Mojtaba Khamenei, son of the late Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, has been chosen as Iran's next Supreme Leader, the country's state media announced on March 8.

item.title: Slovakia to block EU loan to Ukraine if Orban loses Hungarian election, Fico says
item.description: "The main message will be that Slovakia is ready to take over the baton from Hungary if necessary," Slovak Prime Minister Robert Fico said on March 8.

item.title: Zelensky shares new update on liberated Ukrainian territory, says Kyiv 'more positive' than at end of 2025
item.description: Ukrainian forces have liberated up to 435 kilometers of Russian-occupied territory in the country's south, thwarting Moscow's efforts to mount a southern offensive, President Volodymyr Zelensky claimed on March 8.

item.title: Oil prices surpass $100 a barrel for first time since Russia's 2022 invasion of Ukraine
item.description: Brent futures, the global benchmark for oil prices, increased 16% on March 8, near to $108 a barrel. Prices last reached this level in 2022, when Russia launched its full-scale invasion of Ukraine.
